contract.goal: Independently inspect and verify the fixed E2E source fixture in two rounds.
constraints: Use only the existing e2e-source.txt fixture.
Return exactly the requested JSON contract without prose.
deliverables: Audited evidence for inspection and dependent verification.
acceptance_criteria: e2e-source.txt exists and its exact trimmed content is expert-team-e2e-v1.
Both required work items receive independent accepted audits.

inspect-source.objective: Read e2e-source.txt and report its exact trimmed content as evidence; make no changes.
evidence_required: Exact observed content and the inspected relative path.

verify-source.objective: Independently verify e2e-source.txt against the accepted dependency evidence; make no changes.
evidence_required: Exact content comparison and dependency consistency.
